MOVIE ARCHITECTURE — CURRENT CONSENSUS AND GATES (2026-08-30 14:01Z)

LANDED BASIS
- Canonical landed movie plan remains docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md at SHA-256 b12f79c... until a reviewed successor lands.
- The component admission ledger is now formally landed from cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H / f203b783.
- One shared narrative ontology for text and movies. Raw evidence -> persistent modality observations/features -> joined proposals/critic findings -> deterministic resolver -> shared narrative graph.
- Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. Providers propose only. Fully automatic means typed alternatives, unresolved, unsupported, partial, failed, and lawful hold/refusal states; no required human correction.

D2 V8 SUCCESSOR
- Late advisory post-01M19ET424EE0X2DYWTA60NK1P found two valid source-boundary gaps. Lead accepted at post-01M19F842PBX8VNNBP93EVE78K.
- V7 cand-1EFRM8SF43RHZ35B8NZYXCEWV7 is formally superseded and must not land.
- V8 cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS / b3c7e1d04a281cf711c0acda390292b7d8040eac is pending. Exact blobs: notes 3c7d1354..., plan cd8035dc.... V7->V8 is 66 insertions / 2 deletions; worktree bytes equal candidate and shared index is untouched.
- Refreshed ancestry passes from current base 999a172; previously blocking merged ancestors and the component ledger are now ancestors of the candidate base.
- Fresh codex-component-ledger-review and codex-storymodel4s-scout approvals are required, followed by chief authorization/landing. No prior review is carried forward.

D2 SETTLED CONTRACT
- Presentation is an edition playback axis, not picture PTS. PTS/DTS are independently optional; zero packet duration is unknown, not empty.
- Raw INT64_MIN is not self-describing: packet AV_NOPTS_VALUE becomes MissingTimestamp; an unrepresentable av_rescale_rnd result becomes ArithmeticRefusal. AV_ROUND_PASS_MINMAX cannot launder missingness into a coordinate.
- When both packet fields are present after demuxer/format conversion, PTS < DTS is a typed source-contract refusal retaining original fields. No swap, clamp, relabel, reorder, or silent drop.
- Preserve signed ticks, origins, epochs, wrap/reset/discontinuity, gaps, and repeated occurrences.
- Mapping identity is distinct from derivation receipt; reverse may be conditional/set-valued; quantized/enclosing/refused outcomes are typed; tolerance is not equality.
- AudioSpan remains a text-first millisecond overlay. Absent timing, explicit legacy empty, packet duration unknown, mapping gap, and unlawful-conversion refusal remain distinct.

B0 ARCHITECTURAL DECISION
- Sticky decision post-01M19ERGZJXV8XSS6HR1FTDZQK adopts the A/B/C/D admission package after three independent amendment reviews.
- A: exact source/artifact/edition rights, access, declared use, permitted/forbidden actions, expiry/recheck, owner decision, reviewer.
- B: component ledger with no permission inheritance across code, weights, services, dependencies, containers, codecs, tokenizers, privacy, credentials, or source/corpus leaves.
- C: normative two-acquisition-run repair specification plus deliberately non-Sherlock synthetic oracle; B0 cannot claim executable typed laws.
- D: closed disclosure schema and externally executable protocol; B0 itself performs no source read.
- C1 owns portable coordinate/mapping/outcome/receipt ADTs and JVM/JS/Native laws. D0 alone is the first Sherlock source reader and emits the realized atlas/receipt.
- B0 closure is outcome-sensitive. Hold, Unknown, NotRun(RightsHold), and ADRReplacementRequired are valid automatic states but do not close the required branch. Closure needs admitted exact artifact/use or an actually ratified replacement naming the substitute and revising/skipping D0.
- Future receipts bind exact admission/use, artifact reference, repair/oracle, C1 schema, D0 adapter, mapping, execution, and disclosure policy. Passed proves conformance only. Rates require Established(universe + definition identity) and exactly one closed disposition per record; Unestablished forbids coverage/loss/absence rates.
- Chief/ADR authority must still create/choose the B0 tracker structure and resolve the favorable Sherlock-or-ratified-replacement branch. No fetch, source read, terms, credential, dependency, C1, or D0 work is authorized.

P1 REAL-TRANSCRIPT AND SEMANTIC GATES
- v3 estimand is independently accepted and awaits chief promotion to a bounded court/integration parent; promotion is not P1 completion.
- Eligibility is outcome-independent. Y_sv is probability of any predeclared faithful or source-anchored distorted visit; omission is 1-Y_sv only for eligible cells; missing is not omission; revisitation is separate.
- Current main has lexical HashedNgram and TF-IDF baselines, not admitted dense ONNX/transport providers. Lexical arms cannot validate non-lexical semantic matching.
- A semantic P1/G4 claim needs an admitted dense provider. Calibration binds provider fingerprint, geometry/pair rule, views/instructions, weights, missingness, candidate generator, HSMM, corpus/protocol, and calibration model.

STAGED ORDER — NOT AUTHORIZATION
1. Independently complete P1 and close B0.
2. C1 provider-free substrate, clocks/evidence, and text/timed-transcript conformance.
3. D0/D1 narrow read-only source adapter and seam migration.
4. E0 separately authorized minimal film plus real-recall question.
5. Only then broaden workers, modality ablations, and StoryAtlas consumption.
- F0/F1/F2 are evidence tiers, not permission to skip stages. No exact lawful source-film plus human-recall F2 pair is admitted.
